title: Voting in high-stakes bypolls in three States, one U.T. today | LIVE

title: India-US trade talks have reached plateau: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman
description: Negotiations regarding the bilateral trade agreement between India and the US have stalled, reaching a plateau. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that both sides face difficulties in making further concessions. The US aims to reduce its trade imbalance with India, while recent laws have complicated matters. Discussions included tariffs impacting agricultural imports and energy purchases from the US.

title: Nepal ends flood search with over 5,000 still missing, including 189 Indians
description: Nepal has suspended non-essential search operations after the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods that occurred on August 26. The floods resulted in 1,455 deaths, with 5,285 people still unaccounted for, including many foreign tourists. Among the missing individuals are 189 Indians, along with tourists from various other countries. The government has shifted its focus towards reconstruction and rehabilitation efforts rather than continuing search operations.

title: Supreme Court agreed to meet, then changed mind: ONOE panel chief
description: The Supreme Court initially planned an informal meeting with the parliamentary committee on simultaneous elections. However, the meeting was canceled after opposition MPs raised concerns about the appropriateness of the interaction. The Supreme Court expressed that discussing the matter could lead to future judicial review. The proposal for the meeting was suggested by DMK MP P Wilson.

title: Students protest Cornell’s response to gang rape complaint
description: The Ivy League school has been trying to quell a firestorm — on campus and beyond — over its handling of the alleged 2024 gang rape

title: Kheri case: UP changes PP; SC asks Allahabad HC CJ to decide on trial judge
description: The Uttar Pradesh government informed the Supreme Court about replacing the public prosecutor in the Lakhimpur Kheri case. This decision was made in response to allegations raised against the outgoing prosecutor by a witness involved in the case. As the Supreme Court monitors the trial's progress, it was noted that 86 witnesses have been examined thus far.

title: Visa doesn't create absolute right to enter India, says Delhi High Court
description: The Delhi High Court emphasized that foreign nationals do not have an inherent right to enter India. Justice Amit Mahajan pointed out that holding a visa does not ensure unconditional admission. The court noted various factors that could lead to denial of entry, including national security and public health. A plea by a Turkmenistan woman for reasons regarding her entry refusal was dismissed.

title: Mayawati reappoints Akash Anand as national convener in BSP
description: On September 10, Ms. Mayawati had announced the ouster of her nephew Mr. Anand,  setting him “completely free” from BSP

title: Only 15% going to work use public transport: NSO
description: The National Household Travel Survey indicates that only 15% of workers use public transport for commuting. It reveals that 46% of workers rely on two-wheelers and cars, leading to traffic congestion. Walking is the second most common commute mode, with 28.3% of workers traveling on foot. Student commuting patterns differ significantly, with 37% walking to educational institutions.

title: In a record, over 10,000 women clear JEE-Advanced
description: Women's success rate in JEE-Advanced achieved a record high in 2026 while their IIT seat share remained mostly unchanged. A total of 10,107 women qualified, reflecting a 7.5% increase in their qualifying count. Admissions across IITs reached 18,861, with 20% allocated to female candidates. Significant gains were reported for SC and ST candidates in qualification rates.

title: Pahalgam handler rallies LeT support via anti-Israel rhetoric
description: Saifullah Kasuri made controversial remarks regarding the Pakistan army's role in regional conflicts. He threatened to erase Israel from the world map and defend Saudi holy sites. After the Pahalgam attack, he has been active in public events to raise support. High-level meetings between Lashkar-e-Taiba and Hamas have been reported, indicating growing connections. Kasuri's actions reflect an increasing boldness post-attack, as he recruits youth and gathers funds.

title: Shinde meets PM Modi over Maharashtra drought, says Centre assures support for farmers
description: The hour-long meeting focused on the situation facing farmers, including water availability, agricultural conditions and the availability of fodder for livestock

title: Elvis Presley raised $65,000 for USS Arizona Memorial before it opened in 1962
description: Elvis Presley raised $65,000 towards the USS Arizona Memorial in 1961. Completed that year and dedicated in 1962, the 184-foot memorial spans the sunken battleship at Pearl Harbor, where more than 900 crewmen remain entombed.

title: Legislative privilege vs free speech: Supreme Court 7-judge bench may close case
description: Nearly 23 years after the Tamil Nadu assembly's breach of privilege resolution, a Supreme Court hearing is scheduled. The resolution imposed a 15-day sentence on some journalists but has since been withdrawn. Senior advocates claimed that the writ petition's cause of action no longer exists and argued the matter has become academic. As a result, the Supreme Court is expected to dispose of the petitions.

title: Supreme Court quashes Bombay HC order directing Maharashtra FDA to pay ₹5 lakh compensation
description: The case dates back to June 12, when FDA food safety officers in Pune inspected the establishment following a complaint of food poisonining

title: World entering age of flux, India will rise to challenges: EAM S Jaishankar
description: S Jaishankar emphasized the uncertainties facing the world during his speech at the Kautilya Economic Conclave. He expressed confidence in India's ability to navigate challenges such as conflicts and economic volatility. The minister highlighted India's proactive stance during crises, including the COVID-19 pandemic and ongoing geopolitical tensions. Jaishankar called for diplomacy to resolve the Russia-Ukraine conflict, particularly concerning maritime security.

title: Supreme Court may get 3 judges today, to be one short of full strength
description: The Union law ministry has announced the appointment of three judges to the Supreme Court. Justice Sunita Agarwal, Justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya, and Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh have been elevated. These judges were previously chief justices of their respective high courts and will be sworn in soon. With these appointments, the Supreme Court remains one judge short of its sanctioned strength.

title: Form 6 not modified, only declaration added: Election Commission
description: Election Commission officials clarified that there was no change to Form 6, only an additional declaration form was introduced. This statement followed CJI Surya Kant's observation regarding the approval of modified Form 6. Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi accused the Chief Election Commissioner of making illegal changes to the form. The Election Commission denied these accusations and referred to a previous press note for clarification.

title: Rawat seeks meet with Congress brass as Kumari Selja slams his yatra plan
description: Harish Rawat's thanksgiving yatra has prompted a strong response from AICC, emphasizing the need for party unity. Kumari Selja has criticized the yatra as a parallel program that undermines Congress interests. The party leadership has expressed concern regarding Rawat's controversial statements and the potential division of support. A meeting between Rawat and Selja is expected to take place later this week.

title: First international cargo vessel leaves eastern Assam since 1947
description: Once one of India’s busiest river ports, Dibrugarh eyes greater movement of goods

title: Messi set for emotional Argentina farewell in Buenos Aires friendly vs Benin
description: The 39-year-old superstar will play his final match for Argentina on Tuesday (October 6, 2026) — a friendly against Benin at Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires — marking a pivotal moment in the country's football

title: 'Judicial impropriety': Ex-CJI Gavai on SC judge Bhuyan's remarks criticising SIR
description: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan raised concerns regarding the deletion of voters through special intensive revision, facing criticism from former CJI BR Gavai. While Bhuyan emphasized that disenfranchising citizens violates constitutional rights, Gavai expressed reservations about commenting on ongoing legal matters. Former Supreme Court judge Rohinton Fali Nariman also voiced concerns about the democratic implications of voters being removed from lists.

title: Woman declares Rs 67.4L ancestral jewellery in ITR; gets notice, she wins in ITAT
description: The assessment threw up two separate issues. The first concerned jewellery worth Rs 67,39,949 that the woman had disclosed in Schedule AL of her income tax return. The tribunal also examined whether the Rs 12 lakh paid to the HUF represented a genuine brokerage expense when the same person, the HUF's Karta/coparcener, had already received another Rs 12 lakh for the same transaction.

title: California family’s 6,625-acre cattle ranch protected after 112 years
description: The Kinsey family has strategically safeguarded their vast 6,625-acre ranch in Benbow, California, by implementing a conservation easement. This crucial step preserves the land's agricultural, forest, and wildlife values, ensuring the ranch's ongoing functionality while protecting vital habitats for endangered species. David Johnson, a family member, was instrumental in this initiative, with the Northcoast Regional Land Trust planning to acknowledge their dedication to conservation this coming October.

title: Anguish among party workers as former Trinamool leaders being nominated to Upper House: BJP veteran Tathagata Roy
description: A day after the BJP announced candidature of former Trinamool Congress MP Rukmini Mallick alias Koel Mallick to Rajya Sabha, the actor turned politician on Monday formally joined the saffron party.  Ms. Mallick filed her nomination papers for the Upper House in the West Bengal Legislative Assembly in presence of Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and State BJP president.

title: Probe sex assault case against Nagina MP Azad, court directs Delhi cops
description: A Delhi court has ordered the completion of an inquiry into a sexual assault complaint against Chandrashekhar Azad. The complainant accused Azad of raping her under the pretext of marriage and claimed the police did not register an FIR. The police sought additional time for the inquiry, but the complainant opposed this request. The court rejected the police's plea and emphasized that the alleged offence is punishable with life imprisonment.

title: India, Switzerland eye deeper ties in trade, investment, tech
description: India and Switzerland have signed five agreements to strengthen cooperation in trade and mobility. The two countries aim to enhance market access for Indian exports and attract Swiss investments in key sectors. A new mobility agreement will facilitate easier access for Indian professionals and students to Switzerland. Both leaders discussed global conflicts and emphasized the importance of dialogue for peace.

title: Rajya Sabha polls: 8 fresh BJP faces for UP, Hardeep Puri among 2 ministers dropped
description: BJP has chosen not to renominate Union ministers Hardeep Singh Puri and B L Verma for Rajya Sabha. This decision raises speculation about a possible reshuffle of the council of ministers by PM Narendra Modi. Since several ministers have been given organization roles, it indicates their continuation in government may be unlikely. Puri's term ends in November, and he may be reassigned for the Punjab assembly polls.

title: SIR row: Will annul EC orders not in keeping with law, says Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court has asked the Election Commission to clarify decision-making processes related to voter roll revisions. It emphasized that decisions should be taken unanimously or by majority among commission members only. Senior advocate Vikas Singh argued for preserving records and scrutiny of the commission's actions. The court will examine allegations of unilateral actions against the Chief Election Commissioner.

title: NCW issues safety guidelines to step-up monitoring of app-based transport services
description: The National Commission for Women has released guidelines aimed at improving safety for women passengers using app-based transport services. These measures include verifying the background of drivers and ensuring proper identification matches. Additionally, the guidelines address issues related to late-night travel and unauthorized changes in drivers or vehicles. Aggregators are encouraged to create a verified pool of women drivers to enhance safety.

title: J&K HC quashes PSA detention of Shopian man for ‘showing anti-national tendencies’
description: Jammu & Kashmir high court has quashed the preventive detention of Mashooq Ahmad Shah under the Public Safety Act. The court found the allegations against him to be vague and lacking necessary details. Justice Rajnesh Oswal ruled that his detention violated constitutional guarantees under Article 22(5). Shah had been accused of anti-national activities without sufficient evidence. Consequently, the court directed his immediate release if not wanted in other cases.

title: Woman journalist who accused ACP of sexual harassment during protest among 17 booked by Delhi Police; all granted conditional bail
description: The Delhi Police has not registered an FIR in the sexual harassment case so far; an official told The Hindu that the personnel concerned were performing law and order duties during the protest and argued that registering cases against police personnel for actions taken in the course of such duties could “deter them from working”.

title: JK Rowling donated £10m for MS clinic in her mother’s name; it now helps thousands
description: J.K. Rowling opened the Anne Rowling Regenerative Neurology Clinic in memory of her mother, who died of multiple sclerosis. The clinic focuses on research and treatment of various neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease. The funding aims to attract world-class researchers to develop new therapies and potentially find a cure. It has already hosted numerous clinical appointments and research projects since its inception.

title: 19,000 West Bengal voters to miss bypolls as appeals remain pending in tribunals
description: Out of the 19 Appellate Tribunals set up by the Election Commission in March, only 16 remain functional, as three retired judges — Justice T.S. Sivagnanam, Justice Ranjit Bag and Justice Indrajit Chatterjee — have quit, citing various functional issues. Their positions remain vacant.

title: Mission Shakti: How India’s 2019 anti-sat missile test in space caught US off guard
description: India conducted an unexpected anti-satellite missile test in 2019, which surprised US security agencies completely. The former NRO officer David Grusch recounted his experiences during the incident on a podcast. India announced its capability after destroying a defunct satellite, making it the fourth country to achieve such technology. This test led to concerns about debris affecting US satellites in orbit.

The emergency meeting of the Mecca Defence Alliance in Riyadh led to this commitment. Saudi-backed forces are also launching an offensive against the Houthis in Yemen to regain control.

title: Not now daal-ing, says MAGA, as Montana governor comes to India to sell pulses
description: Montana's Governor Greg Gianforte is heading a delegation to India to promote agricultural exports. The focus is on selling lentils, peas, and chickpeas to the world's largest consumer of pulses. This trip highlights the growing tension within the Republican party regarding international trade and immigration. Many in the GOP criticize Gianforte's outreach to India amidst concerns about jobs for Americans.

description: In a stunning display of skill, India's U17 women's team triumphed over Iraq with a jaw-dropping 14-0 victory in their qualifiers. Anushka Kumari shone brightly as the star of the match, scoring five goals and clinching the Player of the Match accolade. Abhista Basnett was instrumental as well, netting two goals and highlighting the team's cohesive efforts. After a brief pause due to weather, the team quickly regained their momentum.

title: In 2009, Google’s Eric Schmidt bought a ship; by 2022, it mapped 1.3m sq km of seafloor
description: In 2009, Eric and Wendy Schmidt took a significant step in marine conservation by acquiring a fisheries protection vessel, rebranding it as Falkor. This vessel became a hub for oceanographic research and exploration, hosting over 1,000 scientists and charting more than 1.3 million square kilometers of the ocean by 2022.

title: No apology, no handshakes from Indian players: Is this why PCB denied NOCs for WCL?
description: Pakistan Champions have withdrawn from the World Championship of Legends after the PCB refused to issue NOCs. The withdrawal follows the board's demands for an apology from Indian players concerning past matches. As a result, Pakistan Champions will not be participating in the ongoing season, ending their campaign prematurely. The PCB and WCL could not reach an agreement on several conditions concerning past events.

title: Congress 'elevates' Imran Masood: Muslim outreach or message to Akhilesh?
description: In Uttar Pradesh, Congress is setting the stage for the 2027 assembly elections amidst complicated alliance dynamics with the Samajwadi Party. The selection of Imran Masood as state chief has ignited concerns about Congress's approach to the alliance and the contentious seat-sharing talks. Masood's clear statements on the party's electoral strategy suggest underlying tensions that might define their coalition's effectiveness in challenging the BJP.

title: Bypolls in 5 assembly constituencies, 1 LS seat tomorrow: Key contests to watch
OFFSIDE: Why Sir Alex Ferguson vs Pep Guardiola is no longer a debate
description: Sir Alex Ferguson built dynasties from Aberdeen to Old Trafford, while Pep Guardiola has spent his career managing football’s richest and most powerful institutions. With Manchester City’s financial breaches and Barcelona’s Negreira affair now part of the historical record, the old debate over who was the greater manager looks increasingly lopsided.

Naomi Osaka’s family mission: How did her Haitian roots inspire her work?
description: Naomi Osaka's heartfelt bond with Haiti is rooted in her family's foundation, which was formed in 1999 to uplift the community. Her inaugural trip to Haiti occurred in October 2017, followed by another visit after her first Grand Slam win in 2018. Engaging with local children, she championed educational initiatives and allocated part of her earnings for earthquake relief. This connection deeply influences Osaka's ongoing philanthropic endeavors.

title: Saudi-led coalition targets Red Sea territory held by Houthis. What's Pak's role?
description: Islamabad has not publicly acknowledged direct involvement in Saudi Arabia's offensive inside Yemen. However, several reports point that Pakistani forces could be helping Saudi Arabia shift more of its military resources towards the war by taking over defensive responsibilities inside the kingdom. That could allow Saudi forces to concentrate on the offensive against the Houthis without Pakistan formally becoming a combatant in Yemen.

title: Chirag Paswan's UP gamble: Why PM Modi's 'Hanuman' is flexing his muscle against allies
description: Chirag Paswan's decision to contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly election marks an expansion of LJP (Ram Vilas). With plans to prepare for all 403 seats, the move could test the party's ability to build a Dalit vote base, influence close BJP-SP contests and strengthen its bargaining power within the NDA. His political journey from the 2020 Bihar split to a 19-seat win in 2025 provides the backdrop.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35m mansion: Why does it have a $1.75m twin in Illinois?
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion, Moyenage, has a fascinating architectural connection to a $1.75 million home in Wheaton, Illinois. Both properties were designed by architect Jarvis Hunt for steel magnate Jay C. Morse, with the Ohio estate reportedly based on his earlier Illinois residence. The 10,000-square-foot House of Seven Gables retains historic details, including fireplaces, oak panelling, beamed ceilings and carved woodwork, despite being relocated in 2017.

title: BJP drops all 8 Uttar Pradesh Rajya Sabha members - what it means
description: The outgoing BJP members, apart from Hardeep Singh Puri and BL Verma, are Arun Singh, Neeraj Shekhar, Geeta Shakya, Brijlal and Seema Dwivedi. The eighth seat belonged to former deputy chief minister Dinesh Sharma, who resigned on September 11 after being appointed lieutenant governor (LG) of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. His term was due to end on November 25, like those of the others.

title: Marc Benioff, wife gave $100M to UCSF; 5 years later, children’s hospital opened
description: Marc Benioff and Lynne Benioff significantly contributed $100 million to UCSF for a new children's hospital. This hospital opened in February 2015, featuring advanced facilities designed exclusively for pediatric care. In addition, they made another $100 million donation in 2014 to further support pediatric research and clinical programs. The hospitals were renamed to honor the Benioffs for their generous contributions to children's health care.
